content.title: Yes, RHORI ’s Kelsey Swanson Has 2 Boyfriends: Her Love Life Explained
content.text: Originally appeared on E! OnlineKelsey Swanson is already making waves in the Ocean State.In fact, The Real Housewives of Rhode Island star's unconventional love life had many of her costars talking during the Bravo series' season one premiere."My boyfriend's family is probably one of the most prominent families in the state of Rhode Island and he has allowed me a life of not being able to work," the 31-year-old revealed in a confessional during the April 2 debut episode. "He is a good person, he is a good man and for a good five months of the year he's gone. So, I'm in a literal empty house where it's just me."But when Kelsey's boyfriend—whose identity she kept a secret—is in Florida half the year, she has full reign of his massive, multimillion-dollar New England mansion."I live a life of luxury and I've been lucky to be a lady of leisure for 10 years now," the former Miss Rhode Island continued. "Living in a 16,000-sq. foot home, the house literally has everything I need. Four kitchens, 79 TVs, the closet, best part. We have to stay in a different zip code just to get to the bedroom."My relationship is very unorthodox. This man dates multiple people. For the first half of the year, my man is in Miami and, when he's in Miami, he's with somebody else. But now, I'm at that crossroads where I just hit 30 and I want more from myself. I want to be in a committed relationship with one person, but at this stage in his life, there's not one thing he's going to change. He is who he is, and either I accept it, or I have to leave.Of course I love him, and that's what sucks because I do care so much about him.The picnic, there was questions of what kind of relationship that I was in. If Rosie or any of the other girls has a question about polygomy - Listen, my relationship from day one there were rules, I accepted a lot of the things and that's it.More from E! OnlineBut long-distance living isn't the only unique aspect of the couple's romantic arrangement."My relationship is very unorthodox," Kelsey acknowledged in her confessional. "This man dates multiple people. For the first half of the year, my man is in Miami and, when he's in Miami, he's with somebody else. But now, I'm at that crossroads where I just hit 30 and I want more from myself. I want to be in a committed relationship with one person, but at this stage in his life, there's not one thing he's going to change.""He is who he is," she lamented, "and either I accept it, or I have to leave."Noam Galai/BravoUnsurprisingly, Kelsey's RHORI cast mates couldn't help gossiping about her unique circumstances during a picnic she didn't attend. The topic of conversation prompted Rosie DiMare to question whether or not her costar is a polygamist."I thought Kelsey was that," Rosie said. "Her boyfriend has a girlfriend here and a girlfriend in Florida, no?"And after Alicia Carmody wondered how Kelsey splits up her holidays, Rosie took things a step further by asking, "What are you saying? She has another boyfriend?"All the chatter eventually got back to Kelsey, who took issue with Rosie's line of questioning."People seem to not be able to stop talking about my relationship," Kelsey shared in a confessional. "But, Rosie, are you asking questions or are you already saying, 'I heard this, and she is this, and they are that'? Because that's a bad path to go down and it's going to end up ugly for you."Cut to a preview of the upcoming episodes in which Kelsey puts any uncertainty to rest by declaring, "The two people in my life are the most wonderful people ever," prompting Rosie to react with, "Now you're saying that you do have two boyfriends. Like, what?!"Find out more about Kelsey's relationships when The Real Housewives of Rhode Island airs Thursdays at 9 p.m. on Bravo.In the meantime, keep reading to learn more about the cast.Alicia CarmodyAlicia Carmody is kick-starting her boss-babe era, pushing her way into her fiancé Billy’s popular restaurant, Pizza Mamma. A proud self-described “flip-flopper,” Alicia might call you a “whor-ah” one minute and pull you into a hug the next. When Alicia opens the vault on her past, she is faced with navigating long-standing relationships and personal growth that leaves one lifelong friend completely blindsided. Kelsey SwansonKelsey Swanson has lived a charmed life as a beauty queen playing house in a castle owned by her wealthy boyfriend. Now at a crossroads, Kelsey must decide between the comfort of her gilded arrangement and a future on her own terms. When her loyalty to Liz is tested, Kelsey worries about going up against the group’s heaviest hitter and losing her greatest cheerleader. Ashley IaconettiFresh from finding her Prince Charming on television, influencer and former The Bachelor personality Ashley Iaconetti quickly learns that life after “I do” isn’t as blissful as she imagined. Between raising two young children, adjusting to life in Rhode Island and co-owning a struggling café with her husband, Jared, Ashley’s loyalties are tested when Rosie claims she never has her back. Liz McGrawRhode Island’s cannabis queen, Liz McGraw, isn’t just running one of the country’s most successful dispensaries, she’s also the person to know in the smallest state in the union. When she and husband Gerry learn they’re about to become grandparents, Liz makes one thing clear – she will not be trading couture for a rocking chair. As she prepares for a new chapter in her family life, shifting dynamics within her inner circle test her influence and the bonds she’s long held close. Rulla Nehme PontarelliGrounded in tradition and guided by faith, Rulla Nehme Pontarelli puts family above all else. Proud of her Lebanese roots, she brings deeply held values into the group, especially when it comes to marriage. When rumors about her husband begin to circulate, Rulla is forced to confront uncomfortable questions that challenge her beliefs, resilience and commitment, putting her personal life under an unrelenting spotlight. Jo-Ellen TiberiJo-Ellen Tiberi may not be known for cooking dinner, but she’s never short on spilling tea. When sensitive information involving Rulla’s marriage circulates within the group, Jo-Ellen finds herself caught between honesty and discretion. Unresolved issues with her mother resurface, forcing her to confront long-buried childhood wounds and reckon with the personal cost of always being the one who tells it like it is. Rosie DiMareFormer Rhode Island television news anchor Rosie DiMare and her husband, Rich, are leveling up, trading their cozy over-the-garage apartment for a sprawling dream home. As Rosie focuses on growing her local lifestyle program, she also faces challenges within her inner circle, leaving her to reassess loyalties and where she truly fits in with this evolving, close-knit group. Dolores CataniaFriend and familiar face Dolores Catania leaves the Jersey Shore behind to spend the summer in Rhode Island with her close friend, Liz McGraw. Together, the two embark on a new entrepreneurial venture — a menopause gummy brand — while soaking up some sun, fun and a little drama along the way.
